output.question: Who is OpenAI's CTO?
output.answer: As of November 2026, I couldn't find a single company-wide CTO at OpenAI. The title is held by division-level leaders instead. Uday Ruddarraju was promoted to Chief Technology Officer, Compute, according to a July 20, 2026 report. Vijaye Raji is Chief Technology Officer of Applications, as TIME listed him in September 2026. The last company-wide CTO was Mira Murati, who held the role from May 2022 to September 2024 and then left.

key_facts.fact: Uday Ruddarraju was promoted to Chief Technology Officer, Compute, after a year as Head of Compute and Infrastructure. He oversees OpenAI's compute strategy and the infrastructure used to train its frontier models.
Vijaye Raji is listed as Chief Technology Officer of Applications at OpenAI.
Mira Murati was OpenAI's CTO from May 2022 to September 2024.

passages.quote: Chief Technology Officer, Compute ... will oversee OpenAI's compute strategy and the infrastructure used to develop and train its frontier AI models.
Chief technology officer of applications, OpenAI
She served as chief technology officer of OpenAI from May 2022 to September 2024.

caveats: I didn't find an OpenAI primary source, such as its own leadership page, confirming that there is no company-wide CTO. That conclusion comes from secondary sources.
Search results also said Srinivas Narayanan, CTO of enterprise/B2B applications, was leaving OpenAI. I couldn't open that source (HTTP 429), so I haven't confirmed it.
Leadership could have changed between September 2026 and today.
